description:
Run Mistral OCR on a PDF or image, returning structured markdown per page.

Input `document` is one of:
  - { type: "document_url", documentUrl: "https://...pdf" }
  - { type: "image_url", imageUrl: "https://..." | "data:image/..." }
  - { type: "file", fileId: "<id-from-files-api>" }

Options:
  - `pages`: array of 0-indexed page numbers or string like "0-5,7".
  - `tableFormat`: 'markdown' (default) or 'html'.
  - `extractHeader` / `extractFooter`: include page header/footer when present.
  - `includeImageBase64`: embed extracted image bytes as base64 in the response.
  - `document_annotation_format`: JSON schema for whole-document structured extraction.
  - `bbox_annotation_format`: JSON schema for extracted image / bbox annotations.
  - `confidence_scores_granularity`: 'page', 'word', or 'block'. 'block' adds
    per-block content/type confidence under `pages[].blocks[].confidence_scores`
    and requires OCR 4.1 or newer.
  - `includeBlocks`: return paragraph-level blocks (bounding box + type) in reading
    order — titles, lists, tables, images, equations, captions, code, references,
    aside text, header, footer, signature. Requires OCR 4 (mistral-ocr-4-0) or newer;
    older models accept the flag but return an empty `blocks` array.

Returns `pages[].markdown` plus optional `pages[].hyperlinks`, `header`, `footer`,
`images` bounding boxes, `blocks`, annotations, confidence scores, and `dimensions`.

bbox_annotation_format.description: JSON Schema for structured annotations of each extracted bounding box or image.

json_schema.description: Named JSON Schema and optional strictness for the extracted annotation.

description.description: Description of the annotation to extract.

schema.description: JSON Schema object defining the fields to extract into the annotation.

strict.description: Whether the annotation must strictly follow the supplied JSON Schema.

type.description: Only json_schema is accepted by OCR annotation formats.

confidence_scores_granularity.description: Confidence granularity. 'block' also fills pages[].blocks[].confidence_scores and requires OCR 4.1 (mistral-ocr-4-1) or newer.

documentUrl.description: HTTPS URL to a PDF or image.

type.description: Read the image from the URL or data URI in imageUrl.

fileId.description: ID of a file previously uploaded via the Files API.

type.description: Read a previously uploaded file identified by fileId.

document.description: Document to process, supplied as a document URL, an image URL or data URI, or an uploaded file ID.

document_annotation_format.description: JSON Schema for a structured annotation extracted from the entire document.

json_schema.description: Named JSON Schema and optional strictness for the extracted annotation.

description.description: Description of the annotation to extract.

schema.description: JSON Schema object defining the fields to extract into the annotation.

strict.description: Whether the annotation must strictly follow the supplied JSON Schema.

type.description: Only json_schema is accepted by OCR annotation formats.

document_annotation_prompt.description: Instructions for whole-document structured extraction. Requires document_annotation_format.

extractFooter.description: Extract each page footer into its footer field and remove it from the page markdown.

extractHeader.description: Extract each page header into its header field and remove it from the page markdown.

imageLimit.description: Maximum number of images to extract from the document.

imageMinSize.description: Minimum height and width of an image to extract.

includeBlocks.description: Return paragraph-level blocks (bounding box + type) per page. Requires OCR 4 (mistral-ocr-4-0) or newer.

includeImageBase64.description: Include base64-encoded data for extracted images in the response.

pages.description: Zero-based page numbers to process, as an array or comma-separated numbers and ranges such as "0-5,7".

tableFormat.description: Format for extracted tables: Markdown or HTML.

name: mistral_ocr

blocks.description: Paragraph-level blocks in reading order. Populated when `includeBlocks: true` and the model is OCR 4 or newer.

confidence_scores.description: Populated only when `confidence_scores_granularity: 'block'`. Fields are null when the signal is absent (an image-only block has no content to score).

image_id.description: Set on type:image — references the matching entry in `images[]`.

table_id.description: Set on type:table — references the matching entry in `tables[]`.

title: Mistral OCR (document to markdown)
